title: Elux Firerose 5000 Berry Bang 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Berry Bang from the Elux Firerose 5000 collection of outstanding Nic Salt flavours is an unmissable treat for fans of complex, yet perfectly balanced fruit blends. It’s primary flavour is a mouth-watering melange of rich Berries, with hints of strawberries, raspberries and blueberries each lending their characteristic profiles to an exquisite berry rush. Adding irresistible complexity to that panoply of rich, smooth berries is Cranberry – a bold layer of juicy tartness that offsets those summer flavours to perfection. Doubling down on this is the presence of Lemon, its sun-soaked citrus sharpness adding a zesty edge to the mix of berries that elevates this fabulous blend to delicious heights. With a 50VG/50PG blend, Berry Bang ensures a perfectly balanced vape that’s ideal for those who enjoy both intense flavour and satisfying yet discreet cloud production. The Nicotine Salt formulation provides a silky smoothness of the vape and is suitable for use in any MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping device. Discover the delicious world of Elux Firerose 5000 Nic Salt e-liquids. This captivating range is inspired by some of Elux’s most popular disposable vape flavours, offering the same intensity of flavour but with the versatility and convenience that comes from 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of vape devices. Experience all dozen delicious Elux Firerose flavours available at Vapestore.
